records.name: Ill Flash
records.evidence: Dragon Ball Wiki states that in Xenoverse 2 Ill Flash is one of Super Buu's Super Skills and the Future Warrior can obtain it from the Skill Shop. The Future Warrior technique list independently includes Ill Flash.

records.name: Spiral of Condemnation
records.evidence: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies it as unique to Fused Zamasu (Half-Corrupted); the Xenoverse 2 character documentation lists it in that character's moveset with CaC marked No. Independent ID-list evidence also marks its skill code DNZ as not CaC.
